rust_oracle: rust-oracle.jsonl — 21 cases live rustc 1.98.1 + x_data_mcp rlib (evidence/identity invalidity, empty selection, as_of before bars, unknown units, OHLC invalidity, duplicate date, negative sums, exact-MAX boundary, precision-loss, selected years, already-yearly, blank identity)

environment.module: src_node/algorithms/yearly.mjs on NM-013 Dec engine (BigInt, zero deps)

semantics_mirrored: validation order: identity/period/evidence -> empty input/selection -> per-bar scan (date<=as_of, strictly increasing, OHLC bounds, non-negative vol/amt) -> missing-year (ascending, first) -> per-year sums
natural-year contiguous groups; first-open/max-high/min-low/last-close; actual last trading date; year_unfinished = year==as_of.year
sum_known: unit unconfirmed OR any None -> unknown BEFORE overflow; checked_add chain + subtraction round-trip verify -> InexactSum on any precision loss (no silent rescale-to-fit)
lineage {base_daily_version_id, local-natural-year-v1, first/last trading dates}; output mirrors AnnualSeries
error text verbatim: 'invalid fixed QFQ daily input: {reason}' / 'requested natural year is absent: {y}' / 'exact decimal sum is not representable'
notes: no JS Number for contract values — all arithmetic via Dec BigInt engine
checked_sub overflow maps to InexactSum consistent with Rust None-path
out_of_scope: memoized aggregate_key, DB/service wiring, all-market generation
limitations: evidence modelled as {confirmed,value} shape mirroring EvidenceValue::is_confirmed — typed boundary documented
